phoneNumber.description: A unique identifier for the PSTN phone number.

extension.description: Extension for a PSTN phone number.

isMainNumber.description: If `true`, the phone number is used as a location CLID.

tollFreeNumber.description: If `true`, the phone number is a toll-free number.

telephonyType.description: The telephony type for the number.

isServiceNumber.description: If `true`, the phone number is a service number; otherwise, it is a standard number. Service numbers are high-utilization or high-concurrency PSTN phone numbers that are neither mobile nor toll-free.

id.description: Unique identifier of the owner to which PSTN Phone number is assigned.

type.description: Type of the PSTN phone number's owner.

firstName.description: First name of the PSTN phone number's owner. This field will be present only when the owner `type` is `PEOPLE` or `VIRTUAL_LINE`.

lastName.description: Last name of the PSTN phone number's owner. This field will be present only when the owner `type` is `PEOPLE` or `VIRTUAL_LINE`.

displayName.description: Display name of the PSTN phone number's owner. This field will be present except when the owner `type` is `PEOPLE` or `VIRTUAL_LINE`.
